findings.note: Leaf symlinks are explicitly accepted by _target_escapes_via_symlink, but _repo_relative calls Path.resolve() and therefore records an in-repository symlink referent rather than the lexical publication target in TRANSACTION.json. Commit still replaces the lexical symlink entry, while rollback/recovery operates on or validates the recorded referent; this can leave a committed artifact at POST after purported rollback or make the resolver's own journal unrecoverable, violating the atomic publication and crash-recovery contract.
